actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 396 - 5 (Roll no. 146). (text: CR H2392)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 396 - 5 (Roll no. 146). (text: CR H2392)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H2402-2403)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1642.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2392-2393)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 25.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-36.
Reported by the Committee on Small Business. H. Rept. 119-36.
Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 25 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses, women-owned small business concerns, Small Business Development Centers, Women's Business Centers, and career and technical education graduates.
dimensions.evidence: small businesses on hiring graduates from career and technical education programs

dimensions.assessment: Facilitates informational outreach and networking assistance without imposing mandatory hiring requirements or financial burdens.
dimensions.evidence: providing educational information to small businesses on hiring graduates from career and technical education programs

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending increases, appropriations, or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Amends the Small Business Act to add specific outreach and connection duties to existing small business support centers.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Small Business Act to include requirements relating to graduates of career and technical education programs

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory addition to the operational duties of Small Business Development Centers and Women's Business Centers.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall take effect... and shall apply...
